WITH base AS (
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('month', analytics_period_inputs.observed_at) AS "analytics_period_inputs.observed_at", MEASURE(analytics_period_inputs.amount) AS "current"
  FROM analytics_period_inputs
  WHERE (analytics_period_inputs.observed_at >= '2023-12-01' AND analytics_period_inputs.observed_at <= '2024-03-31')
  GROUP BY 1
),
calendar_keys AS (
SELECT
  base."analytics_period_inputs.observed_at" AS "analytics_period_inputs.observed_at", base."current" AS "current", DATE_ADD(base."analytics_period_inputs.observed_at", INTERVAL '-1 month') AS "__calendar_1"
  FROM base
),
compared AS (
SELECT
  t."analytics_period_inputs.observed_at" AS "analytics_period_inputs.observed_at", t."current" AS "current", cmp_1."current" AS "prior"
  FROM calendar_keys t LEFT JOIN calendar_keys cmp_1 ON cmp_1."analytics_period_inputs.observed_at" = t."__calendar_1"
  WHERE (t."analytics_period_inputs.observed_at" >= '2024-01-01' AND t."analytics_period_inputs.observed_at" <= '2024-03-31')
),
derived AS (
SELECT
  compared."analytics_period_inputs.observed_at" AS "analytics_period_inputs.observed_at", compared."current" AS "current", compared."prior" AS "prior", ((CAST((compared."current" - compared."prior") AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) / compared."prior") AS "growth"
  FROM compared
),
filtered AS (
SELECT
  derived."analytics_period_inputs.observed_at" AS "analytics_period_inputs.observed_at", derived."current" AS "current", derived."prior" AS "prior", derived."growth" AS "growth"
  FROM derived
  WHERE derived."analytics_period_inputs.observed_at" >= '2024-03-01'
)
SELECT
  filtered."analytics_period_inputs.observed_at" AS "analytics_period_inputs.observed_at", filtered."current" AS "current", filtered."prior" AS "prior", filtered."growth" AS "growth"
  FROM filtered
  ORDER BY "analytics_period_inputs.observed_at"
  LIMIT 10
cases.oracle:
-- oracle:mc04_calendar_output_truth
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', observed_at) AS month, sum(amount) AS current
  FROM cssql_oracle.analytics_period_inputs WHERE tenant = 'A' GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT current.month, current.current, prior.current AS prior,
  (current.current - prior.current) / NULLIF(prior.current, 0) AS growth
FROM monthly current LEFT JOIN monthly prior ON prior.month = current.month - INTERVAL '1 month'
WHERE current.month = TIMESTAMP '2024-03-01' ORDER BY current.month;

WITH base AS (
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('month', analytics_period_inputs.observed_at) AS "analytics_period_inputs.observed_at", MEASURE(analytics_period_inputs.amount) AS "current"
  FROM analytics_period_inputs
  WHERE (analytics_period_inputs.observed_at >= '2024-01-01' AND analytics_period_inputs.observed_at <= '2024-03-31') AND analytics_period_inputs.id = '3'
  GROUP BY 1
),
windowed AS (
SELECT
  base."analytics_period_inputs.observed_at" AS "analytics_period_inputs.observed_at", base."current" AS "current", LAG(base."current", 1) OVER (ORDER BY base."analytics_period_inputs.observed_at") AS "prior"
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  windowed."analytics_period_inputs.observed_at" AS "analytics_period_inputs.observed_at", windowed."current" AS "current", windowed."prior" AS "prior", ((CAST((windowed."current" - windowed."prior") AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) / windowed."prior") AS "growth"
  FROM windowed
  ORDER BY "analytics_period_inputs.observed_at"
  LIMIT 10

WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', observed_at) AS month, sum(amount) AS current
  FROM cssql_oracle.analytics_period_inputs WHERE tenant = 'A' GROUP BY 1
), observed AS (SELECT month, current, lag(current) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prior FROM monthly)
SELECT month, current, prior, (current - prior) / NULLIF(prior, 0) AS growth
FROM observed WHERE month = TIMESTAMP '2024-03-01' ORDER BY month;
